label: archive-matched-comparison
command:
import gzip,json,shutil
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import file_digest,write_json
from nisayon.evaluation.scoring import score_file
root=Path('/Users/danielwahnich/workspace/nisayon-codex')
src=root/'artifacts/development-ablation-001'
out=root/'docs/experiments/results/development-ablation-001'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
bindings=[]
def keep(p,packed=False):
 rel=p.relative_to(src); dst=out/(str(rel)+'.gz' if packed else rel)
 dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 raw=p.read_bytes(); dst.write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0) if packed else raw)
 bindings.append({'source':str(rel),'source_sha256':file_digest(p),'path':str(dst.relative_to(out)),'sha256':file_digest(dst),'bytes':dst.stat().st_size,'encoding':'gzip' if packed else 'identity'})
for name in ['frozen-suite.json','comparison-ledger.json','comparison-score.json','condition-reservation.json','preparation-costs.json']:
 keep(src/name)
ledger=json.loads((src/'comparison-ledger.json').read_text())
for case in ledger['cases']:
 keep(src/case['id']/'joint-freeze.json')
 for arm in ['A','B']:
  keep(src/case['id']/arm/'trial.json')
  for phase in ['diagnostic','confirmation']:
   folder=src/case['id']/arm/phase
   if not folder.is_dir():continue
   for p in sorted(folder.glob('*.json')):keep(p,packed=p.name=='derived-replay.json')
   execution=folder/'execution'
   for name in ['artifact-manifest.json','integrity.json','frozen-protocol.json','joint-freeze.json','invocation.json','bundle-header.json']:
    p=execution/name
    if p.is_file():keep(p)
   keep(execution/'bundle.json',packed=True)
record=root/'.nisayon/runs/aa77eb4a5ac040ff9528e2cabf89aec5/run.json'
shutil.copyfile(record,out/'experiment-command.json')
copied=score_file(out/'comparison-ledger.json')
original=json.loads((src/'comparison-score.json').read_text())
assert copied==original, 'Portable score differs from retained score'
write_json(out/'archive-manifest.json',{'schema':'nisayon.comparison-archive.v1','raw_root_locator':str(src),'frozen_execution_commit':'a9984af39c89e6aacf8c65fd3a7db6cb05c5eca8','experiment_command_sha256':file_digest(out/'experiment-command.json'),'portable_score_matches':True,'files':bindings,'limits':['Raw simulator traces and licensed policy weights are not copied into Git. Re-evaluation needs the explicitly bound raw store. Scoring verifies the original decision, diagnosis and confirmation bytes portably.']})
print(json.dumps({'archive':str(out.relative_to(root)),'retained_files':len(bindings),'bytes':sum(b['bytes'] for b in bindings),'portable_score_matches':True,'fair':copied['fair'],'outcomes':{a:v['outcomes'] for a,v in copied['arms'].items()}},indent=2))
